title: FleetForge v2.6.4 Enterprise IT Edition
changelog: Permanent fix for update detection: direct GitHub origin priority, query cache-busting, and multi-endpoint fallback
Completely eliminated reports folder creation across the application, setup installer, and AppData
Any required deployment reports and audit logs are saved directly in AppData\Local\FleetForge without subfolders
Automated CDN edge invalidation pipeline (Purge-Cdn.bat & Release-Update.bat)
Directory optimization: cleaned legacy leftover report files, empty folders, and locked version to 2.6.4
